title: First Release Of USAF’s New HACM Hypersonic Cruise Missile Has Happened Over Australian Range
summary: The U.S. and Australia have conducted the first flight test of the Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) over an Australian range. title: Northrop logs first flight for self-funded drone wingman
summary: Northrop Grumman has successfully conducted the first flight of its self-funded YFQ-48A drone wingman. The aircraft performed fully autonomous taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers, and landing over the Mojave Desert in California. This marks a significant step in the development of autonomous uncrewed combat aircraft.

title: U.S. Navy Completes Successful Test Flight of Blackbeard Long-range Hypersonic Strike Missile
summary: The U.S. Navy successfully completed a flight test of the Blackbeard long-range hypersonic strike missile. The test involved an F/A-18E/F Super Hornet at Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland. This represents a key developmental step towards the program's Early Operational Capability.

title: Kraken and Saab UK develop pioneering autonomous ‘drone seeker’ vessel
summary: Kraken Technology Group and Saab UK have developed and tested a pioneering prototype autonomous 'drone seeker' vessel for maritime environments. The system integrates Kraken's K3 SCOUT with Saab's Giraffe 1X radar. This collaboration aims to create a rapidly deployable Counter-UAS (C-UAS) seeker capability at sea.
